head_commit.message:
ci(evidence): verify the original locked fetch in all four retained contexts

Retain the measured 73ab release repair, complete 40a fetch refusals and Legacy History operation boundaries. Verify only the failed fetch subgate at the fixed 73ab head and actual merge, under both original stable quality and nightly fuzz toolchains, using the unchanged command owner and timeouts.

Preserve all original failures, cancellations, source distinctions and acceptance limits.

name: Retained original locked fuzz-graph fetch
on:
  push:
    branches: [fix/chain-retained-failure-readback-20261104]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pon-retained-locked-fetch-validation.yml
permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  CI: "true"
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
  RUST_TEST_THREADS: "1"
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
jobs:
  locked-fetch:
    name: Original locked fetch (${{ matrix.kind }}, ${{ matrix.context }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.job_minutes }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - kind: head
            context: quality
            tested: 73ab6e9a83bcc836e261d93f9bb23ceafe556758
            toolchain: 1.95.0
            job_minutes: 180
          - kind: head
            context: fuzz
            tested: 73ab6e9a83bcc836e261d93f9bb23ceafe556758
            toolchain: nightly-2026-10-01
            job_minutes: 45
          - kind: prospective-merge
            context: quality
            tested: 88f899241b1050b1be5bc55f2c1b077b1afa1c10
            toolchain: 1.95.0
            job_minutes: 180
          - kind: prospective-merge
            context: fuzz
            tested: 88f899241b1050b1be5bc55f2c1b077b1afa1c10
            toolchain: nightly-2026-10-01
            job_minutes: 45
    env:
      MEASURED_HEAD: 73ab6e9a83bcc836e261d93f9bb23ceafe556758
      MEASURED_BASE: dd6e1c3cbeacbdc532b0679297835b3a0aac78f0
      MEASURED_TESTED: ${{ matrix.tested }}
      MEASURED_KIND: ${{ matrix.kind }}
      MEASURED_CONTEXT: ${{ matrix.context }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the fixed original head or actual merge
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ matrix.tested }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify exact source and execute unchanged preflight
        env:
          FETCH_OUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/retained-locked-fetch-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ matrix.kind }}-${{ matrix.context }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir "$FETCH_OUT"
          args=(--kind "$MEASURED_KIND" --expected-head "$MEASURED_HEAD")
          if test "$MEASURED_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$MEASURED_BASE" --expected-merge "$MEASURED_TESTED")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$FETCH_OUT/source-before.json" 2>&1 | tee "$FETCH_OUT/source-before.log"
          bash scripts/project-preflight.sh --audit 2>&1 | tee "$FETCH_OUT/preflight.log"
      - name: Install only the original context toolchain in fresh private homes
        env:
          FETCH_OUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/retained-locked-fetch-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ matrix.kind }}-${{ matrix.context }}
          RUSTUP_HOME: ${{ runner.temp }}/retained-locked-fetch-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ matrix.kind }}-${{ matrix.context }}-rustup
          CARGO_HOME: ${{ runner.temp }}/retained-locked-fetch-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ matrix.kind }}-${{ matrix.context }}-cargo
          CARGO_TARGET_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/retained-locked-fetch-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ matrix.kind }}-${{ matrix.context }}-target
          RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir "$RUSTUP_HOME" "$CARGO_HOME"
          case "$MEASURED_CONTEXT" in
            quality) command=(rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy) ;;
            fuzz) command=(rustup toolchain install nightly-2026-10-01 --profile minimal --component rust-src) ;;
            *) exit 2 ;;
          esac
          "${command[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$FETCH_OUT/toolchain-install.log"
          rustc --version --verbose 2>&1 | tee "$FETCH_OUT/compiler.log"
          cargo --version --verbose 2>&1 | tee "$FETCH_OUT/cargo-version.log"
          rustup component list --installed 2>&1 | tee "$FETCH_OUT/components.log"
      - name: Execute only the original locked fetch with the original process owner
        env:
          FETCH_OUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/retained-locked-fetch-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ matrix.kind }}-${{ matrix.context }}
          RUSTUP_HOME: ${{ runner.temp }}/retained-locked-fetch-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ matrix.kind }}-${{ matrix.context }}-rustup
          CARGO_HOME: ${{ runner.temp }}/retained-locked-fetch-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ matrix.kind }}-${{ matrix.context }}-cargo
          CARGO_TARGET_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/retained-locked-fetch-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ matrix.kind }}-${{ matrix.context }}-target
          RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          import sys
          from pathlib import Path
          sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts/ci')
          from ci_observation import finish, pin_source, run, tool_root, tool_versions
          output = Path(os.environ['FETCH_OUT'])
          environment = dict(os.environ)
          context = environment['MEASURED_CONTEXT']
          versions = tool_versions()
          if context == 'fuzz':
              binary_dir = tool_root() / ('fuzz-' + versions['TRNM_CARGO_FUZZ_VERSION']) / 'bin'
              environment['PATH'] = str(binary_dir) + os.pathsep + environment.get('PATH', '')
              environment['RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN'] = versions['TRNM_FUZZ_TOOLCHAIN']
              environment['CARGO_TARGET_DIR'] = str(Path(environment['CARGO_TARGET_DIR']) / 'fuzz')
          if environment['RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN'] != os.environ['RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN']:
              raise ValueError('ORIGINAL_FETCH_TOOLCHAIN_MISMATCH')
          observations = []
          report = {'schema': 'trnm-retained-locked-fetch-only-v1', 'result': 'FAIL',
                    'context': context, 'observations': observations,
                    'requested_head': environment['MEASURED_HEAD'],
                    'requested_kind': environment['MEASURED_KIND'],
                    'requested_tested_commit': environment['MEASURED_TESTED'],
                    'rustup_toolchain': environment['RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN'],
                    'rustup_home': environment['RUSTUP_HOME'], 'cargo_home': environment['CARGO_HOME'],
                    'command_timeout_seconds': 900, 'original_term_grace_seconds': 10,
                    'acceptance_granted': False, 'full_quality_or_fuzz_executed': False,
                    'fuzz_targets_executed': False, 'dependency_policy_checks_executed': False}
          code = 1
          try:
              expected = pin_source()
              report['source_expected'] = expected
              if expected != environment['MEASURED_TESTED']:
                  raise ValueError('ORIGINAL_FETCH_SOURCE_MISMATCH')
              # This is exactly the failed argv in both retained original producers.
              # Omitting timeout reuses ci_observation.run's original 900s/TERM10s owner.
              observed = run(['cargo', 'fetch', '--locked', '--manifest-path', 'tests/fuzz/Cargo.toml'],
                             output / 'fetch.log', env=environment, expected_source=expected)
              observations.append(observed)
              code = observed['exit_code']
              report['result'] = 'PASS' if code == 0 else 'FAIL'
          except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
              report['error'] = str(error)
              print(str(error), file=sys.stderr)
          finally:
              finish(output, report, ['tests/fuzz/Cargo.toml', 'tests/fuzz/Cargo.lock',
                                     'rust-toolchain.toml', 'scripts/ci/tool-versions.env',
                                     'scripts/ci/run_supply_chain.py', 'scripts/ci/run_fuzz_smoke.py',
                                     'scripts/ci/ci_observation.py'])
              print(json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
              log = output / 'fetch.log'
              if log.is_file():
                  sys.stdout.buffer.write(log.read_bytes())
                  sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
          raise SystemExit(code if code != 0 or report['result'] == 'PASS' else 125)
          PY
      - name: Recheck the fixed source even after failure
        if: always()
        env:
          FETCH_OUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/retained-locked-fetch-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ matrix.kind }}-${{ matrix.context }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$FETCH_OUT"
          args=(--kind "$MEASURED_KIND" --expected-head "$MEASURED_HEAD")
          if test "$MEASURED_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$MEASURED_BASE" --expected-merge "$MEASURED_TESTED")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$FETCH_OUT/source-after.json" 2>&1 | tee "$FETCH_OUT/source-after.log"
      - name: Preserve source, toolchain, exact fetch output and failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: retained-locked-fetch-${{ matrix.kind }}-${{ matrix.context }}-73ab6e9a83bcc836e261d93f9bb23ceafe556758-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/retained-locked-fetch-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ matrix.kind }}-${{ matrix.context }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
